s2.ptxt: Install the engine control computer bracket with the 4 screws.
Connect the clamp and install the engine control computer with the 2 bolts.
Connect the 2 engine control computer connectors to the engine control computer.

item.ptxt: When installing the connector, be careful not to allow foreign matter such as mud or water to adhere to the connector connection.

s2.ptxt: Install the air cleaner case with the 3 bolts and clamp.
Install the air cleaner filter element.

s-1.ptxt: Install Air Cleaner Cap w/ Air Cleaner Hose

s2.ptxt: Install the hinge portion first, then install the air cleaner cap with the 3 clamps.
Install air cleaner hose No.1 to the throttle body assembly and release the lock of air cleaner hose clamp No.1.

item.ptxt: Align the triangular projection of air cleaner hose No.1 with the throttle body bolt on the right front side of the vehicle.
Align the position of air cleaner hose clamp No.1 using the triangular projection of air cleaner hose No.1 as a reference.

s2.ptxt: Connect the clamp and intake air flow meter connector.
Connect the fuel vapor feed hose and fuel vapor feed hose No.2 to vacuum switching valve assembly No.1.
Connect the clamp and vacuum switching valve connector.
Install the engine cover assembly No.1 with the 2 nuts.
